svg.title: The objects a railfs mount hangs off
svg.desc: Data model of the VFS objects railfs uses: the file_system_type builds a super_block, which points at the mount's railfs_options and at the root dentry; a dentry names an inode, and each railfs inode points back at its super block and holds the kref-counted path the peer resolves by. An inode's type comes from i_mode, set from what the peer reported, and the inode and file operation tables are installed from it. An inset shows the parent-child side of the dcache: a directory dentry's d_children list holds the child dentries that have been looked up, each linked to the next by d_sib.
svg.text: the path it was found at
